tldr: Adds DELETE /folders, which deletes many folders of a user in 1 request and 1 transaction.
goal: The web client sends one request per selected folder, so a bulk delete makes N round trips and is not atomic.

story.heading: Vault adds a bulk folder delete command
story.body: The command checks the ids, deletes the user's matching folders, then pushes a vault sync.

story.heading: Entity Framework deletes folders by id list
story.body: The repository deletes the given folder ids for one user in a single call.

story.heading: Dapper runs a folder delete procedure in a transaction
story.body: The repository passes the ids as a table parameter to Folder_DeleteByIds and commits or rolls back once.

story.heading: API adds the DELETE /folders endpoint
story.body: The endpoint accepts up to 500 ids outside self-hosted and sits behind the VFO1Foundation feature flag.

story.heading: Bulk delete reaches the API from the top
story.body: The API calls the vault command, which uses the shared repository interface and the platform push service.

components.summary: Adds DELETE /folders, which takes a list of folder ids and passes it to the vault command.
Adds a command that deletes many folders for one user and then pushes a full vault sync.
Adds DeleteManyAsync, which runs Folder_DeleteByIds in one SQL transaction.
Adds DeleteManyAsync, and DeleteAsync now calls it with a single folder id.
Adds the Folder_DeleteByIds stored procedure and its migration script.

decisions.title: One request deletes many folders
decisions.why: The client needs one atomic call per selection, not N calls to DELETE /folders/{id}.
decisions.alternative: Send one DELETE /folders/{id} per selected folder

decisions.title: Dapper deletes inside one transaction
decisions.why: The delete commits all folder rows together or rolls back all of them.
decisions.alternative: Delete each folder in its own transaction

decisions.title: Full vault sync replaces per-folder notifications
decisions.why: Deleting a folder moves its ciphers, so clients need a full vault sync.
decisions.alternative: Push one folder delete notification per folder

flows.title: Delete many folders for a user
